summary: Frontend-only regression after WebP image optimization for /hero and /projects. Verified responsive srcSet selection on mobile (375px), tablet (768px) and desktop (1366px), Hero carousel, Sobre image, Projects grid, lightbox navigation, mobile PWA button and WhatsApp CTA. All in-scope images render without 404s or console errors.

observations.projects_cards: All grid cards use *-768.webp with srcset (e.g., Janela-de-correr-1-768.webp, Banheiro-1-768.webp, Varanda-1-768.webp) — correct
observations.lightbox_desktop: Opened Janela-de-correr lightbox on 1366px — rendered projects/Janela-de-correr-1-1600.webp; prev/next arrows and close button visible; counter '5 de 36' shown
observations.sobre_image: historia-2-1600.webp loaded with srcset on desktop; no layout break
observations.console: 0 errors. Only 3 benign framer-motion warnings about non-static position container (pre-existing, unrelated to WebP optimization)
observations.mobile_regression: PWA Baixar App button present, WhatsApp floating CTA (wa.me) present, mobile menu toggle rendered

out_of_scope_findings: /cores/COD.*.webp swatch images report naturalWidth=0 when below the fold (lazy-loaded) but return no HTTP 404. Not part of this task (scope is /hero and /projects). Mentioning only for context — not a regression caused by this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/images.js helper is minimal and correct; regex only matches /hero and /projects paths and preserves non-matching src — safe fallback.
Consider using <picture> with <source type=image/webp> for stronger fallback on browsers without WebP (very minor since global WebP support is ~97%).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebP optimization validated across 3 viewports. srcSet correctly resolves to -768 on <=768px and -1600 on desktop. Lightbox uses 1600 variant. Lead_events (13) in Mongo were not touched (frontend-only test).
